Spatial art lab · round 12 · portrait 9:16 · phase: Develop · 23 Sep 2026

The panther, photographed, not rendered.

Round 11's panther fur read as generated. Same compositions, re-rendered with the prompt written as a real night photograph. Left: before. Right: after.

Up close

TellBefore (H)After (P)
FurSeparate glossy strands, each with a highlightSoft dense mass, clumped where damp, mostly in shadow
WaterA droplet on every whisker tipA few, uneven
ColourBronze fur, strong rosettesNear-black, rosettes only where the light grazes
FocusEverything sharp, edge to edgeEye sharpest; ear, shoulder and background soft
PixelsClean, HDR micro-contrastFine sensor grain, natural contrast

The fix was the prompt: write it as a photograph (400mm f/2.8 wide open, ISO 6400, 1/250 s, one torch from the side), name what is soft, ask for grain, and ban "every hair". Notes: alignment/ai-texture-notes.md.
